Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Is the superior version of Echo of Harmonies chainable?
i.e. if you use the vote card which was placed on the "Echoing"
minion, can another minion then play Echo of Harmonies to take the
card for themselves?

What about referenda that don't require cards (such as the vote
to burn certain cards-in-play)? Can you play this ability on
those types of votes at all?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <cJTS7.18159$5W5.8...@typhoon.ne.mediaone.net>, Jozxyqk

<jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> writes:
>Is the superior version of Echo of Harmonies chainable?
>i.e. if you use the vote card which was placed on the "Echoing"
>minion, can another minion then play Echo of Harmonies to take the
>card for themselves?

I can't see any reason why not. It does appear that the card is still
used to call the referendum the second time around, so qualifies under
the text "Move the political action card used to call the referendum
from your ash heap to this vampire at the end of the action."

>What about referenda that don't require cards (such as the vote
>to burn certain cards-in-play)? Can you play this ability on
>those types of votes at all?

Nope, because there's no political action card to play with.

Messages.Author: GreySeer
Messages.Body:
"Jozxyqk" <jfeu...@eecs.tufts.edu> wrote in message
news:cJTS7.18159$5W5.8...@typhoon.ne.mediaone.net...

> Is the superior version of Echo of Harmonies chainable?
> i.e. if you use the vote card which was placed on the "Echoing"
> minion, can another minion then play Echo of Harmonies to take the
> card for themselves?

Sure, it doesn't care wether the card came from your hand or not, just that
the card is in the ash heap.

> What about referenda that don't require cards (such as the vote
> to burn certain cards-in-play)? Can you play this ability on
> those types of votes at all?

If the card is not a Political Action card ( like Anarch Revolt ),
definately not.

I can think of a case that I'm not sure of though.

I've put a Rumors of Ghenna in play in a previous turn.
I call a vote to burn it and it passes.
Can I now play Echo of Harmonies?

Messages.Author: messier37
Messages.Body:
What happens if Echo of Harmonies is used at superior with Ancient
Influence or Political Stranglehold? Since the card moves from the
ash heap to the minion and is later burned off the minion to be called
again(rather than being played from a methuselah's hand) can the vote
be called again?

Thanks
Doug
